About.title: The identity
About.p1: H2V Systems is led by Hiury Vilanova — hands-on engineering when traffic grows, legacy gets in the way, or a new product needs a real ship date.
About.p2: The <cyan>H2</cyan> and <cyan>V</cyan> come from the founder's name: an owner for the project, short communication, and technical calls explained without marketing gloss.
About.missionDesc: Reduce incidents and rework with software you can actually run — readable logs, predictable deploys, scope we honor.
About.visionDesc: Be the team you call when you need someone who read the stack trace and suggests the next step without pushing an endless rewrite.
About.valuesDesc: Say no when the timeline doesn't work, write down what we agreed, and keep email/Slack/WhatsApp answered during business hours.
About.founderDesc: Software engineer with a track record in Java/Kotlin/Spring, React, and environments where incidents are expensive — usually leads technical discovery and PR review.

Faq.title: Frequently
Faq.subtitle: Questions that usually come up first. If yours is different, use the contact form.
Faq.noAnswerDesc: Talk directly with our team. We respond within 2 business hours.

items.q: How much does developing a custom system cost?
items.a: The investment varies according to the complexity and scope of the project. We work with fixed-price projects and monthly maintenance contracts. After an initial conversation, we present a detailed and transparent proposal, with no surprises.

items.q: What is the average development timeline?
items.a: It depends on the scope, but simple MVPs are ready in 4 to 8 weeks. More complex systems take between 3 and 6 months. Our agile methodology guarantees incremental deliveries from the very first weeks.
Yes. We offer monthly maintenance plans with monitoring, security updates, bug fixes and new features. The system grows alongside your business.

items.q: Is it possible to integrate with systems I already use?
items.a: Absolutely. Integrations are one of our specialties. ERP, CRM, payment gateways, marketplaces, legacy systems: if there is an API or a database, we can connect it.

items.q: How does communication work during the project?
items.a: Full transparency. You have access to weekly status meetings, project dashboards, a direct channel on Slack/WhatsApp and progress reports. No surprises at the end of the month.
Yes, always. The confidentiality of client information is non-negotiable. We sign NDAs for all projects before beginning any technical discussion.

Services_desenvolvimento.metaDesc: Tailored systems in React, Node, Java and Kotlin. Robust engineering, clean code, predictable delivery.
Services_desenvolvimento.title: Custom software
Services_desenvolvimento.subtitle: Systems designed specifically for your business, built with the best engineering practices and enterprise-grade code.
Services_desenvolvimento.intro: Every company has unique processes, pains and opportunities. Generic solutions rarely deliver the expected result. We build systems that fit your operation perfectly and scale along with it.
benefits: Up to 70% reduction in operational rework
Faster time-to-market with agile methodology
Your own code with no vendor lock-in
Architecture ready to scale 10x without refactoring
Complete technical documentation and knowledge transfer

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: MVPs ship in 4 to 8 weeks. Full projects range from 3 to 6 months with incremental deliveries.

faq.q: Do you use a specific language?
faq.a: We pick the ideal stack per project. We work with TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Python and Go. Always mature technologies.

faq.q: How is communication during the project?
faq.a: Weekly status, direct Slack/WhatsApp channel, progress dashboard and demos every sprint.

Services_web-mobile.metaDesc: Web apps, PWA, React Native and Flutter. Modern interfaces focused on conversion and experience.
Services_web-mobile.title: Web
Services_web-mobile.subtitle: Modern and performant interfaces with user experience as priority. PWA, SPA and native apps focused on conversion.
Services_web-mobile.intro: The interface is the front door of your digital business. We build experiences that load fast, work on any device and convert visitors into customers.
benefits: Lighthouse score 90+ on performance and accessibility
Average 35% increase in conversion rate
Full compatibility with iOS, Android and Web
Installable PWA without App Store or Play Store
Multi-language support and native offline mode

faq.q: PWA or native app, which to choose?
faq.a: It depends. PWA is cheaper and covers 90% of needs. Native is better when you need deep device features.

faq.q: Do you publish on App Store and Play Store?
faq.a: Yes. We handle the full process of publishing, validation and updates.

faq.q: Can an old app be migrated?
faq.a: Yes. We audit, plan the migration and implement gradually without breaking what works.

Services_arquitetura.metaDesc: Microservices, robust APIs, cloud-native and infrastructure ready to grow. AWS, Docker, Kubernetes.
Services_arquitetura.title: Architecture
Services_arquitetura.subtitle: We design infrastructures that grow with your business. Microservices, robust APIs and cloud-native to support any demand.
Services_arquitetura.intro: Systems that fail under growth cost customers, revenue and reputation. We design architectures that absorb traffic spikes, fault-tolerant and cost-optimized.
benefits: Support for millions of requests/day without degradation
Up to 50% infrastructure cost reduction
99.95% high availability with automatic failover
Deploy in minutes with full CI/CD pipeline
Full observability with logs, metrics and tracing

faq.q: Is moving to microservices worth it?
faq.a: Not always. Technical analysis first. Modulith or a well-built monolith can serve for years before breaking into services.
Single-cloud with moderate vendor lock-in delivers 90% of value with 30% of cost. Multi-cloud only when regulatory required.

faq.q: How long does a migration take?
faq.a: Legacy systems: 3 to 9 months with gradual approach (strangler fig). No big-bang.

Services_dados.metaDesc: Modeling, query optimization, ETL pipelines and Big Data. PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and BigQuery.
Services_dados.title: Databases
Services_dados.subtitle: Efficient modeling, query optimization and data pipelines. We turn raw data into actionable intelligence.
Services_dados.intro: Data is the most valuable and most underused asset of most companies. We structure your database to answer fast, scale cheap and generate real insights.
benefits: Queries up to 100x faster with proper indexing
Automated ETL pipelines with Airflow or n8n
Real-time dashboards with Metabase, Grafana or Looker
Backup, replication and disaster recovery configured
GDPR compliance with encryption at rest and in transit

faq.a: It depends on the domain. SQL for strong relations. NoSQL for high volume and flexible schema. Hybrid works well in most cases.
Yes. Oracle to PostgreSQL, MySQL to Postgres, on-premise to cloud. Always with zero downtime.
Yes. Schema audit, slow-query analysis and optimization plan delivered in up to 2 weeks.

Services_integracoes.metaDesc: We connect your systems, eliminate rework and automate processes with RPA, APIs and n8n.
Services_integracoes.title: Integrations
Services_integracoes.subtitle: We connect your systems, eliminate rework and automate repetitive processes. From ERP to CRM, everything integrated and flowing.
Services_integracoes.intro: Every company has a set of systems that don't talk to each other. The result is Excel spreadsheets, copy-paste and human error. We automate that flow and give hours of productivity back to your team.
benefits: Average saving of 200 hours/month on repetitive tasks
Integration with ERPs (SAP, Totvs, Sankhya), CRMs and gateways
Real-time webhooks between systems
Email, spreadsheet and reporting automation
Complete audit logs of all transactions

faq.q: My legacy system has no API. Can it be integrated?
faq.a: Yes. RPA, authorized scraping or direct database access when viable. Always compliant.

faq.q: How much does a simple integration cost?
faq.a: Point-to-point integrations between two known systems: 2 to 4 weeks. Custom quote after analysis.

faq.q: How do you ensure it won't break?
faq.a: Automated tests, retry with exponential backoff, dead letter queue and real-time alerts for any failure.

Services_consultoria.metaDesc: Deep analysis of your tech environment, code review, tech audit and modernization roadmap.
Services_consultoria.title: Technical
Services_consultoria.subtitle: Deep analysis of your tech environment, bottleneck identification and a clear roadmap to modernize your stack.
Services_consultoria.intro: Before coding, it's worth stopping to think. We audit your code, infrastructure and processes to show where the waste, risk and opportunity are.
benefits: Complete technical diagnosis in up to 3 weeks
Prioritized roadmap with estimated effort, cost and impact
Code review with checklist for security, performance and maintainability
Modernization plan with viable steps and clear ROI
Mentoring of internal team in architecture and best practices

faq.q: How does the audit process work?
faq.a: Analysis of code, infra, database and processes. Team interviews. Executive + technical report. Findings presentation and action plan.

faq.q: Do you work alongside our team?
faq.a: Yes. We act as an external squad on specific projects or as continuous mentorship for the internal team.
Minimum 1 month for diagnosis. Continuous follow-up is monthly, with no long lock-in.
